title: Insight · LiveLayer
description: Every bar and every hour of your last event, in kroner: where queues cost sales and where capacity stood empty.

hero.sub: What happened at your last event – and what did it cost? Every bar, every hour, in kroner.

items.d: An overview of the whole event: where there were queues, where capacity fitted, and where it stood empty.
What the queues cost in sales, and what empty capacity cost in rental and volunteer hours.
We go through the results with your bar managers and your F&B lead.

heat.h2: The whole festival on one page.
heat.p: Choose a day. Each row is a bar, each column an hour.
heat.empty: hours of capacity with no guests

demand.p: Bar 4 in the tent, Friday. Demand climbs when the headliner comes on. Capacity does not.

items.t: Queues and the sales that walked away
items.d: Where and when demand was bigger than what the bar could serve.
Bars, terminals and volunteer hours that stood ready with no crowd.
How staffing followed the crowd – and where it didn’t.
How many stood where, and where they did the most good.
What vendors brought, sold and drove home – and how they affected each other.
